Important Admissions Information for Fall 2027 ALL MAJORS ARE IMPACTED at California State University, Long Beach. As a result, incoming students must complete a series of major-specific preparation coursework and meet GPA requirements. Please visit our Major Specific Degree Requirements webpage for more information and to find the correct path and year for your major. Review the following for information related to transfer admissions to CSULB: Transfer Admission Eligibility Overview Transfer Application Process Lower Division Requirements Information for Major Agreements Due to ASSIST text limitations, some information regarding upper-division course options and electives may not be clear below. It is crucial to note that the lower-division course requirements may change from year to year. The specific course requirements (catalog rights) will be determined for the student based on the catalog in effect at the time of their first term at CSULB. While effort is expended to mitigate alterations, agreement language can change with little advanced notice.

Agreement Information


The information below represents a view of articulated lower-division courses between California State University, Long Beach (CSULB) and the sending institution, aligning with the CSULB Academic Catalog. In the tables below, the left column represents CSULB courses, while any corresponding articulated courses are displayed on the right. Important Admissions Information for Fall 2027


ALL MAJORS ARE IMPACTED at California State University, Long Beach. As a result, incoming students must complete a series of major-specific preparation coursework and meet GPA requirements. Please visit our Major Specific Degree Requirements webpage for more information and to find the correct path and year for your major.


Review the following for information related to transfer admissions to CSULB:

  • Transfer Admission Eligibility Overview
  • Transfer Application Process
  • Lower Division Requirements Information for Major Agreements


Due to ASSIST text limitations, some information regarding upper-division course options and electives may not be clear below. It is strongly recommended that agreement information along with CSULB Catalog information be reviewed when assessing a degree's requirements. It is crucial to note that the lower-division course requirements may change from year to year. The specific course requirements (catalog rights) will be determined for the student based on the catalog in effect at the time of their first term at CSULB. While effort is expended to mitigate alterations, agreement language can change with little advanced notice.
